## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

1. "DOGEY" — shiba-ish dog: tan/yellow blocky head with pointy ears, black nose, side-eye; body hoodie; stats balanced.
2. "PEPE" — green frog with big eyes, wide mouth; agile, fast.
3. "CHAD" — square-jawed blonde human with sunglasses, muscular; heavy.
4. "CATTO" — white/cream grumpy cat; combo speed, maybe "Grumpy Catto".
Maybe 5th "SKELETON"? Keep 4.

- Doge: "Much Punch" (dash punch) — high damage charge.
- Pepe: "Rare Pepe" — teleport? "Croak Smash" leap slam.
- Chad: "Gigachad Slam" — ground pound shockwave.
- Catto: "Zoomies" — rapid multi-hit.

Simplify specials as energy-based burst with unique FX:
- Each fighter has meter filled by dealing/taking damage, special button when full.
- Special = powerful attack with forward dash + AOE, different color/effect.

- 2.5D-ish arena movement on a plane: x/z. Camera behind player at slight angle, look at midpoint? Best for mobile: fixed-ish isometric/third person. A side-on fighter might be simpler. Virtual joystick to move, punch/jump/block buttons. Auto-target camera follows player. Arena circular. Opponent AI approaches and attacks.
- Melee hit detection: range 1.7, angle. Punch combo steps (left/right hooks/uppercut). Buttons: Attack (tap for combo), Heavy? Keep two buttons: PUNCH & KICK plus block and jump and special. Mobile clutter; use joystick + 4 buttons: punch, kick, block, special? Jump maybe double-tap? Better: buttons: Punch, Kick, Block (hold), Special. Jump via swipe up? Hmm, jumping adds complexity. Let's include jump button as small above. Layout: right cluster: big PUNCH, small KICK, BLOCK, SPECIAL; JUMP small. That's 5. We can arrange.
- Keyboard: WASD/arrows move, J punch, K kick, L block, Space jump, U special, P pause. Also gamepad? Not necessary.

- AI: state machine wandering/approach/attack/block/retreat, reaction to player attacks, difficulty based on rounds. Ensures fun and beatable. AI throws punches/kicks and blocks.

- punch: arm extends via rotation and scale; body twist.
- kick: leg raises.
- block: arms crossed in front.
- jump: legs tuck.
- hurt: recoil.

AI:

Actor class:
- `update(dt, opponent, input, game)` handles physics and states.
- Player input provided as {moveX,moveZ, punch,kick,jump,block,special}. AI generates same shape plus action flags (edge triggers). To handle edge triggers, main input snapshot includes booleans `punchPressed` etc. We'll have `InputState` with pressed flags cleared after consumption or after frame.
- For AI, produce pressed booleans based on decision.
- `update` state machine:
  - decrement timers: attack cooldown, combo window, invuln, hitstun.
  - if hp<=0 -> state ko; skip.
  - if state 'ko' or 'victory': physics only.
  - if hitstun > 0: state hurt; apply knockback; no input.
  - if state 'special': update special authored behavior, handle hits.
  - if state 'attack': update attack elapsed; hit detection; allow queued combo.
  - else:
    - block if input.block && grounded -> blocking true; movement slowed; else false.
    - jump if pressed and grounded.
    - special if pressed and meter>=100.
    - punch/kick if pressed -> start attack (snap facing).
    - movement based on moveX/moveZ * speed * (blocking?.35:1).
    - face movement direction, but if not moving face opponent; if in close range idle face opponent.
    - apply gravity/jump.
    - clamp arena.
  - Always: update root pos/rotation; animate.
- `startAttack(name)` sets state attack, attack={...ATTACKS[name]}, stateTime=0, hitDone=false, combo window.
- Attack update:
  - stateTime += dt; lunge early: move forward a bit. `if (attack.lunge && stateTime<attack.activeStart) pos += forward*lunge*dt`.
  - active window check: if !hitDone and stateTime between windup and windup+active => tryHit.
  - end => state idle; if queued next attack and comboStep<3 => start immediate.
  - combo steps: `punch1` advances to punch2/punch3 if pressed during attack. Player pressing punch during attack queues `queuedAttack`. On finish, if queued and combo window -> start next in chain.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D meme fight game for phone/tablet in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`, resuming from a prior failed run that produced no code.

## Requirements
- Complete playable game, not a prototype.
- 3D, mobile-first (phone/tablet), responsive touch controls plus keyboard support.
- Make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly on completion.
- Save screenshots as small `.jpg` files (viewport ≤1280px wide); read only the latest one. Full-size PNG only for fine detail.

## Decisions
- Built an original Three.js arena brawler: 4 meme fighters (DOGEY, FROGGO, CHAD, CATTO), auto-facing 1v1 combat, best-of-3 rounds, AI opponent.

- Downloaded local Bangers + Outfit fonts into `fonts/`.
- Synthesized all audio with WebAudio (no audio assets).

  - `src/utils.js`, `src/effects.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/combat.js`, `src/ui.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/main.js`.

- Combat includes punch chains, kick, block, jump, air attack, specials, meter, combos, hitstop, screen shake, slow-mo KO, damage numbers, particles, confetti, announcer/toasts.
- Implemented dramatic meme UI (title, character select, HUD, pause, results, how-to-play, loading).
- Created a debug API on `window.__memeFight` for automated checks (`startFight`, `skipIntro`, `press`, `stick`, `state`).
